state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors define the Degeneration-of-Thought (DoT) problem of self-reflection and propose the Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) framework to elicit divergent chains of thought. They report that GPT-3.5-Turbo with MAD can surpass GPT-4 on Common MT, that an adaptive break and a modest level of 'tit for tat' disagreement are needed for good performance, and that an LLM judge prefers the side that uses its own backbone model.
title: Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) with a judge counters Degeneration-of-Thought in self-reflection
